How To Choose A Tile And Grout Cleaning Company

October 18, 2024
Table of Contents

Besides online shopping, you can also browse the web for different tile grout cleaning serviceproviders. However, your journey of finding and hiring one doesn’t end there since you need to evaluate their credibility and skills.

Therefore, it is totally challenging to choose a trained, licensed, and insured tile cleaning service, yet we are here to share some tips to help you. Understand these tips and use them to hire your best cleaning company to remove the stubborn dark and yellow stains on your tiles and grouts.

Tip1. Cleaning equipment is just one thing you need to consider for hire

Sure thing, getting the right cleaning equipment is essential in making the cleaners’ job more efficient, yet if the housemaid doesn’t have the proper training to use it, then it becomes useless. Therefore, you also need to look into the skills of the cleaning company in manipulating machines for grout steam cleaning.

Look for a company that uses safe and effective cleaning methods that won’t damage your tiles or harm your family members or pets. Modern professional equipment can thoroughly clean grout and tiles without abrasives or harsh chemicals. Prioritize companies using eco-friendly solutions.

Alongside this, you can ask the cleaning service provider to show some proof of their personnel’s Institute of Inspection, Cleaning, and Restoration Certification (IICRC). This certification proves that their people are well-trained with the best practices in the cleaning and disinfection industry.

Tip2. Prioritize Quality Over Cheap Rates

When researching companies, the cheapest option isn’t always the best. Higher rates typically mean more thorough service and better results.

The internet is a vast ocean of opportunities and scams, so you must be careful with cheap rates for professional grout cleaning service. There can be two consequences for seeing very cheap rates for this service.

  1. It can be a click, bait, and switch process, which is illegal and unethical.
  2. Perhaps, their personnel isn’t that seasoned yet for the job.

So far, the national average for professional porcelain tile cleaningservices is around $460, where it ranges from $300 to $650. Then if we go for a per square foot rate, it will range from $0.50 to $3. Meanwhile, for an hourly rate per cleaner, it will cost around $30 to $50.

Conversely, all cleaning companies give a free estimate service, so take advantage of that and then compare rates from different companies. You can also avail of our free quote by calling our office today.

Tip3. Search Online and Call Them

Do some research online then call potential companies to inquire about their specific processes. Once you found at least three cleaning companies, call them one by one, and ask them specific questions that will help you get to know them. You need to know them before you let them enter your premises. Alongside this, here are some common questions you can ask them over the phone.

  • How long are you in the industry?
  • Can you show some proof that you are insured and bonded?
  • Do you have the license?
  • Can you guarantee to handle my tile and grout cleaning requirements?
  • What other cleaning solutions do you provide?
  • Are your free estimates binding or non-binding? What are the factors that can increase cost?

Get a feel for their customer service and expertise over the phone. The right company won’t hesitate to answer your questions.

Tip4. Consider those Offering Money-Back Guarantees

If you’re not convinced of a company’s abilities, look for those offering satisfaction guarantees or money-back policies. For a cleaning companynot to offer a money-back guarantee, somehow gives you an impression that they’re not confident with their skills. Well, there’s a 50-50 chance it can be true, yet if they offer it, then it must be written in their quoted proposal.

Most professional cleaning services offer a money-back guarantee for reasonable conditions that are fair for both parties. For instance, a 20-year old tile will be impossible to restore in its original finish no matter how deeply it is cleaned. Nevertheless, if it’s all about removing those molds and mildews, then there’s no problem with that.

Tip5. They’re using green and sustainable tile and grout cleaning products

Considering the issues on the environment and health, some commercial cleaning companies use harmful chemicals for their cleaning solutions. With that, you need to ask them about the cleaning products they’re using for the tile and grout cleaning process. Avoid harsh chemicals. Look for green certifications.

Furthermore, here are some of the toxic cleaning products used in the field.

  • Formaldehyde
  • Acids
  • Strong basic solutions
  • Pesticides
  • Fragrances

Luckily, we at Shiny Carpet Cleaning only uses green cleaning solutions that leave no residues that can harm your fabric, pets, and children. Our pros keep a sustainable system for delivering our comprehensive cleaning services.

Tip6. Licensed, Trained, and Insured

Don’t risk uncertified companies handling dangerous chemicals in your home. To ensure you get a quality tile and grout cleaning solutions, their personnel must be duly trained, licensed, and insured. What does it mean?

  • Licensed. All their pros must have a license or certification from the Institute of Inspection, Cleaning, and Restoration Certification (IICRC). This will prove their competencies for the job.
  • Insured and Bonded. The cleaning company’s pros must all be insured so that you have zero liabilities in case something happens to them during work. Also, any damage to property done during work will be covered by the cleaning company, so you get reimbursed.

Alongside this, we are one of the local cleaning service companies that are licensed, insured, and bonded for all kinds of cleaning tasks. You can call our office today, to avail of our free quote and consultation.

Tip7. They’re flexible to offer other cleaning services

A seasoned cleaning service provider is well-rounded in all cleaning chores besides tile and grout cleaning. For instance, we can also offer you a reasonable rate for cleaning your carpets and furniture, after doing your tiles and grout.

When you hire an all-around cleaning company, you’ll have no more reasons to look for another company, so you can save time and energy. With that, you can visit our website or call our office to ask for our other cleaning packages.

Tip8. Ask for a free estimate and the factors that can increase cost

Most homeowners are very particular with price in all cleaning services, so you need to ask if they provide free estimate service. Alongside this, you also need to know if they’re giving out a binding or non-binding free quote, so you won’t get surprised by the additional charges.

In terms of pricing, most companies consider two factors.

  • Stain and Dirt. Rule of thumb, the harder it is to remove those stains and dirt on your tiles and grouts, the higher will be the cost.
  • Tile size. Smaller tiles have more grouts, which means more cleaning, so you can expect a higher price for it.

A quality company will work with you to create a solution that fits your budget without compromising results. Be sure to get an accurate estimate upfront so there are no pricing surprises down the road.

Benefits of a Professional Tile and Grout Cleaning Company

When it comes to keeping your tile and grout immaculate, hiring a professional cleaning service has clear advantages over attempting DIY methods. From saving you time and frustration to improving air quality, the pros offer a wide range of benefits. Here are 5 of the top reasons to let the experts handle your tile and grout cleaning:

  1. Save You From DIY Struggles:Attempting DIY tile cleaning can be labor-intensive and often falls short of fully eliminating grime or stains trapped deep in porous grout. Hiring pros eliminates frustration and ensures excellent results.
  2. Prolong Your Tiles’ Lifespan:Regular professional cleanings prevent permanent damage or mold issues. Thorough cleaning keeps surfaces in great shape for years to come.
  3. Healthier Home Environment:Powerful professional-grade equipment removes allergens, bacteria, and pollutants from tile and grout that household cleaners can’t tackle.
  4. Time Savings:Professionals with top-of-the-line equipment can complete the job quickly versus hours of scrubbing and spot cleaning yourself.
  5. Avoid Costly Damage:Improper DIY cleaning can damage grout and tiles. Professionals know the safest, most effective techniques to clean floors without causing harm.

Trust the tile and grout cleaning experts to keep your floors sparkling and your home healthier.
